compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: CLAUDE.md accurately describes the severity-only review schema and does not reference numeric scores, REVIEW_RESULT, or MIN_SCORE
- DD2: The review-status file format documented in CLAUDE.md matches the actual format (no score= line)

## What to change

**plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md line ~1500** and **CLAUDE.md line ~136**:

In CLAUDE.md rule #8, change:
'dispatching a generic agent with instructions to write reviewer-findings.json with hardcoded scores'
To:
'dispatching a generic agent with instructions to write reviewer-findings.json with hardcoded findings/scores'

This accurately describes that fabricating ANY content (findings or the now-deprecated scores) is prohibited.

**CLAUDE.md line 97 tiered review block** — No changes needed: 'Classifier scores 0-2 → light' refers to the COMPLEXITY CLASSIFIER scores (not reviewer output schema). 'Review dimensions: correctness, verification, hygiene, design, maintainability' remains accurate.

**IMPORTANT**: CLAUDE.md does NOT document the review-status file format explicitly (no score= line to remove). The only relevant change is the hardcoded scores reference above.

**DO NOT**: Add new content to CLAUDE.md or expand the description beyond the minimal fix. Follow CLAUDE.md rule #2 (Architectural Invariants): CLAUDE.md is for agent instructions; no architectural implementation details that agents don't need per-session.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] CLAUDE.md does not contain 'MIN_SCORE' or 'REVIEW_RESULT' (already clean - just verify)
  Verify: ! grep -q 'MIN_SCORE\|REVIEW_RESULT' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/CLAUDE.md
- [ ] CLAUDE.md line about hardcoded scores updated (or verified already accurate)
  Verify: grep -q 'hardcoded' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/CLAUDE.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus, escalate to user immediately
